name: story-actions
title: Actions story
description: Dot animation of browser actions and the resulting page.
usage: Rendering dynamic pages (clicks, waits, scrolls) on a site card. Plays only on screen; shows the rendered page with reduced motion.
avoid: Stories as the main content of a page

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
